newsitem.title: ROMANIA: ROMANIAN 1996 SERVICES ALMOST FLAT ON 1995.
newsitem.headline: ROMANIAN 1996 SERVICES ALMOST FLAT ON 1995.

text.p: The value of commercial services in Romania stood at 3.78 trillion lei in 1996, almost unchanged from the previous year's level in real terms, data issued by the National Statistics Boards showed on Thursday.
The private sector took 74.5 percent of last year's services, slightly up from 73.7 percent in 1995, data showed.
Figures refer to commercial services to the population and exclude transport, mail and telecoms.
